fusions.name: Startled Bristle
fusions.desc: Flares your scales outward at once, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tail-Flag Alarm
fusions.desc: Flicks a scale at the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage and flagging it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Flinch Turned Shell
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 20 damage for 5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spooked Into Motion
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (20% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour is 4% higher at all times.
